prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     Find, take, and inspect object. If approached, take. Then process. Else approach or scan.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Condition ID = IsAreaScanned    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = ProcessObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO ProcessObject
	END
